description: Source code for the torch.package.PackageExporter class and related components, used for packaging and exporting Python modules, pickled objects, and resources into a self-contained package with dependency management.

classes.name: _ModuleProviderAction
classes.description: Enum representing actions that PackageExporter can take on a module (intern, extern, mock, deny, etc.)

classes.name: PackagingErrorReason
classes.description: Enum listing reasons why a dependency may fail to package (e.g., no __file__, extension module, dependency resolution failed).

classes.name: _PatternInfo
classes.description: Dataclass holding pattern matching info for PackageExporter patterns.

classes.name: EmptyMatchError
classes.description: Exception thrown when a pattern marked allow_empty=False is not matched during packaging.

classes.name: PackagingError
classes.description: Exception raised for issues during package export, including dependency errors and unmatched patterns.

classes.name: PackageExporter
classes.description: Main class for exporting code, data, and resources into a self-contained package with dependency management.

methods.name: save_source_file
methods.description: Adds source files or directories to the package for a given module, optionally scanning dependencies.

methods.name: get_unique_id
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for use within the package.

methods.name: _get_dependencies
methods.description: Analyzes source code to find direct module dependencies.

methods.name: save_source_string
methods.description: Adds source code string for a module directly into the package.

methods.name: _write_source_string
methods.description: Writes source code for a module into the zip archive.

methods.name: _import_module
methods.description: Imports a module using the specified importer.

methods.name: _module_exists
methods.description: Checks if a module exists by attempting to import it.

methods.name: _get_source_of_module
methods.description: Retrieves source code of a module if available.

methods.name: add_dependency
methods.description: Adds a module and its dependencies to the dependency graph.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Saves a module's code into the package, resolving dependencies.

methods.name: _intern_module
methods.description: Adds a module as an interned module, including source and dependencies.

methods.name: save_pickle
methods.description: Serializes and saves a Python object into the package, scanning for dependencies.

methods.name: save_text
methods.description: Saves text data as a resource in the package.

methods.name: save_binary
methods.description: Saves raw binary data as a resource in the package.

methods.name: register_extern_hook
methods.description: Registers a hook to be called when modules are externed.

methods.name: register_mock_hook
methods.description: Registers a hook to be called when modules are mocked.

methods.name: register_intern_hook
methods.description: Registers a hook to be called when modules are interned.

methods.name: intern
methods.description: Specifies modules to include in the package based on glob patterns.

methods.name: mock
methods.description: Mocks modules matching patterns, replacing their implementation.

methods.name: extern
methods.description: Marks modules as external, preventing them from being packaged.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Blocks modules matching patterns from being included, raising errors if dependencies are found.

methods.name: _persistent_id
methods.description: Provides persistent IDs for storage objects and pickled objects for serialization.

methods.name: __enter__
methods.description: Enables use of PackageExporter as a context manager.

methods.name: __exit__
methods.description: Finalizes and closes the package, handling exceptions.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Writes data to the zip archive, ensuring no duplicates.

methods.name: _validate_dependency_graph
methods.description: Checks the dependency graph for errors and unmatched patterns.

methods.name: _write_mock_file
methods.description: Writes a mock implementation file into the package.

methods.name: _execute_dependency_graph
methods.description: Processes the dependency graph to write modules and resources into the package.

methods.name: _write_python_version
methods.description: Records the Python version used to create the package.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finalizes and writes out the entire package.

methods.name: _finalize_zip
methods.description: Closes the zip archive after packaging.

methods.name: _filename
methods.description: Generates filename for resources within the package.

methods.name: _can_implicitly_extern
methods.description: Determines if a module can be implicitly marked as external based on its name.

methods.name: dependency_graph_string
methods.description: Returns a dot graph representation of the dependency graph.

methods.name: _nodes_with_action_type
methods.description: Retrieves list of modules with a specific action type.

methods.name: externed_modules
methods.description: Lists modules marked as externed.

methods.name: interned_modules
methods.description: Lists modules marked as interned.

methods.name: mocked_modules
methods.description: Lists modules marked as mocked.

methods.name: denied_modules
methods.description: Lists modules marked as denied.

methods.name: get_rdeps
methods.description: Returns modules that depend on a given module.

methods.name: all_paths
methods.description: Returns a dot graph of all paths from one module to another.
